reason: YouTube with a 30-minute timer already works for me and costs nothing, and I've never paid for a sleep app. I might grab the free version since it plays without ads, but paying 4,900 won a month isn't happening.
objection: The main Pro feature is the one I'm scared of: if I toss around at 3am and it starts playing again, it wakes me up. Then I'm paying to get my sleep broken. Even if I can turn it off, without it Pro is just a fancier timer.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free 14 days it showed me I really fall asleep a lot faster, like 15+ minutes, and the 3am resume never once woke me up, I'd think about the yearly plan.
